description: Local-first connector health configuration for AI Cohesion OS. Start with file exports; add HTTP probes only for systems you control.

connectors.name: Email / Gmail / Outlook export
connectors.notes: Export inbound messages or normalized email events here. Do not store credentials or raw private attachments unless explicitly approved.

connectors.name: CRM / pipeline export
connectors.notes: Lead, deal, quote, or case records exported from HubSpot, Pipedrive, Airtable, Sheets, or a custom CRM.

connectors.name: Calendar / schedule export
connectors.notes: Appointments, deadlines, reminders, and follow-up windows.

connectors.name: Team chat export
connectors.notes: Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram, or internal chat summaries. Prefer summaries over raw private logs.

connectors.name: Website / form webhook events
connectors.notes: Normalized contact forms, booking forms, quote requests, and other inbound workflow events.
